limitations: Registered ledger credits only; missing historical receipts are not inferred.
Local, peer and integrated gates are separate and must not be added together.

Exact gate rates include C/mixed results. Completed ASM migration includes whole-exact C and eligible mixed; pure-C and mixed spans remain separate. Ordinary mixed needs less than 10% inline instruction bytes; documented low-level exceptions remain lower priority.
Integrated_exact is a subset of integrated, dated at integration.
Original envelopes include constants and alignment; task spans are not remaining executable bytes.
Live activity does not change the separately dated verified ROM snapshot.
Family mapping is accounting attribution, not new semantic acceptance; provisional system labels remain provisional.
Rates include preparation, failures and handoffs. Partial windows and distinct cohorts are not causal speedup evidence.

asm_rewrite.scope: Known original ASM function/module spans, including internal literals and alignment; excludes resource ranges. Already migrated code remains in the denominator. Unclassified code is not yet in this catalogue.

c_match.scope: Known original ASM function/module spans, including internal literals and alignment; excludes resource ranges. Already migrated code remains in the denominator. Unclassified code is not yet in this catalogue.

daily.scope: Calendar days in Asia/Shanghai, using original credit occurrence times and currently unrevoked receipts. Range unions deduplicate overlaps within each gate. Cumulative curves cover dated ledger receipts only; the current ROM baseline is never backdated. Missing historical receipts are unknown, not zero recovery. Integration is a separate gate and must not be added to local exact. Current day is partial; no projection. Eligible mixed and pure C remain separate.
